pages.text: When you die, your $(l)armour, offhand, hotbar and accessories$() come back with you.$(br2)Your $(l)pack$() (the rest of your inventory) and your experience stay on your corpse where you fell. Go back for it. Friends can open it too, so be nice.
Every death is counted on the player list ($(l)Tab$()). Every tenth is announced.$(br2)$(o)YOU DIED$() is not a suggestion.
Every kill feeds your $(l)souls$(), even if only a little: more for the elite, a great deal for lords and bosses. Spend them with the Merchant and Blacksmith.
